usedFor: Shopify holds the products, and WebCrawler API reads a page through “Scrape Webpage” after “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Scrape Webpage” in WebCrawler API
bestTemplate.why: A new product has a new page, and the action scrapes its content.

watchOut: “Start Crawl Job” works on a whole site, so use “Scrape Webpage” when one page is enough.
